You keep avoiding climate delay as a major problem for our current catastrophe.

Please acknowledge that even without a single act of economic activity today, the warming of our planet will continue for at least a couple of decades.

Can you acknowledge that?

When greenhouse gas concentrations increase as rapidly as they have done on our planet in the last century, temperatures lag behind by around a quarter of a century (between 15 to 30 years).

Our 2045 climate is already baked in in 2025.

If the straights of Hormuz are closed either by Iran or military action or just insurers not willing to cover, and therefore no tankers crossing… well, giant economies depend on this oil. It’ll be a disaster. Yet another reason for nations to go rapidly to renewables!

It seems you don’t understand delayed climate response.

The emissions from 2015 to 2025 have not yet warmed the planet.

By 2045 we will have warmed the planet to the levels of greenhouse gases of 2025.

Even with zero humans on this planet from today, our climate will reach 3C above 1850 by 2045.

Adding greenhouse gases to the atmosphere doesn’t cause instant warming.

There is a delay of between 15 and 30 years until the planet’s systems reach a new equilibrium - so even if all greenhouse gas emissions reach zero today, by 2045 the planet will have a catastrophic climate 3C above 1850z

The aims of degrowth are good.

Those aims are not going to save humanity.

Even if economic activity has 100% degrowth to zero activity, 3 degrees of warming by 2045 is now already a reality - the greenhouse gases in the atmosphere have a much higher concentration than that already.

Had every nation on earth switched to a degrowth strategy in 2015, we would have had a chance.

But our chance to avert total collapse is now dependent on extreme interventions that are unlikely to be even possible. 

Degrowth will happen automatically by 2050 without any intervention.
